fullTextEN: Hey, do you want to eat cake?

fullTextZH: 我们买一块蛋糕一起吃，要不要？
fullTextEN: Shall we buy a piece of cake to eat together?
But this piece of cake is 45 yuan,
22.5 per person, how to split?
I'll pay 23 yuan,
You pay 22 yuan,
Is that okay?
You want to pay 23 yuan?
Okay, okay, that's fine!
Eat, eat!
Wait a moment!

fullTextZH: 你的是不是比较大块啊？
fullTextEN: Is yours a bigger piece?
Hello, I am Xika,
I am Taiwanese.
How are you? Welcome to Lazy Chinese.
Do you know someone like her?
She doesn't like to spend money,

fullTextZH: 不喜欢别人用她的东西。
fullTextEN: and doesn't like others using her things.
She is afraid others will take too much,
and she will take too little.

fullTextZH: 这种人，我们说她很小气。
fullTextEN: We call this kind of person stingy.

fullTextZH: 今天我要说一个小气鬼的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell a story about a cheapskate.
Please listen,

fullTextZH: 你看过这么小气的人吗？
fullTextEN: Have you ever seen such a stingy person?
There was a restaurant owner,
His restaurant was very famous,
Many people liked it.
Why?

fullTextZH: 因为餐厅的菜非常好吃，嗯！
fullTextEN: Because the restaurant's dishes were very delicious, hmm!
Every day from morning to night,

fullTextZH: 在餐厅里面和餐厅外面，
fullTextEN: Inside and outside the restaurant,

fullTextZH: 都可以闻到很香很香的食物味道。
fullTextEN: You could smell the very fragrant food aroma.
Hmm, very fragrant!

fullTextZH: 因为很多人来餐厅吃饭，
fullTextEN: Because many people came to the restaurant to eat,

fullTextZH: 所以这个餐厅老板赚了很多钱。
fullTextEN: So this restaurant owner made a lot of money.

fullTextZH: 在餐厅的旁边有一间鞋店。
fullTextEN: Next to the restaurant, there was a shoe store.

fullTextZH: 鞋店老板做的鞋子很好穿，
fullTextEN: The shoe store owner made shoes that were very comfortable to wear,
Very comfortable, but not good-looking,
Not pretty.

fullTextZH: 因为没有很多人来买鞋子，
fullTextEN: Because not many people came to buy shoes,
So the shoe store owner doesn't make money.
This shoe store owner,

fullTextZH: 每天都可以闻到很香很香的食物味道，
fullTextEN: Every day he can smell very fragrant food aromas,
which come from the restaurant next door.

fullTextZH: 可是他没有钱去餐厅吃饭，
fullTextEN: But he doesn't have money to eat at the restaurant,
the food there is too expensive.
He often thinks,

fullTextZH: 有一天，他赚很多钱的时候，
fullTextEN: One day, when he makes a lot of money,

fullTextZH: 他要去旁边的餐厅吃饭。
fullTextEN: he will go to the restaurant next door to eat.

fullTextZH: 有一天，鞋店老板要吃午餐了。
fullTextEN: One day, the shoe store owner was about to have lunch.
His lunch was a piece of bread.

fullTextZH: 这个时候，他又闻到很香的味道了。
fullTextEN: At this time, he smelled the fragrant aroma again.
Hmm, so he sat at the doorstep,
smelling that aroma,
smelling that fragrance,
then eating bread.
He closed his eyes,
smelling while eating.
Eating like this,

fullTextZH: 他觉得他不是在吃面包，
fullTextEN: he feels like he's not eating bread,

fullTextZH: 他觉得他在吃餐厅的菜。
fullTextEN: He feels like he is eating the restaurant's food.
Hmm!
The shoe store owner is very happy,
He thinks this method is very good.

fullTextZH: 以后，他每天都坐在门口吃饭，
fullTextEN: Afterwards, he sat at the door to eat every day,
smelling the restaurant's aroma,
while eating.
The restaurant owner found it very strange,
He thought,
Hmm,

fullTextZH: 为什么鞋店老板每天坐在门口吃饭呢？
fullTextEN: Why does the shoe store owner sit at the door to eat every day?
Hmm,
He watched for a long time,
He knew, ah!
Why.
So one day,

fullTextZH: 餐厅老板去鞋店老板的家，
fullTextEN: The restaurant owner went to the shoe store owner's house,
and gave him this piece of paper.
Can you guess what this piece of paper is?
This piece of paper is a bill.

fullTextZH: 账单就是你用东西、吃东西以后，
fullTextEN: A bill is what you get after using or eating things,

fullTextZH: 告诉你要付多少钱的纸。
fullTextEN: telling you how much money you need to pay.

fullTextZH: 对，餐厅老板给鞋店老板一张账单。
fullTextEN: Right, the restaurant owner gave the shoe store owner a bill.

fullTextZH: 可是为什么要给他一张账单呢？
fullTextEN: But why give him a bill?

fullTextZH: 鞋店老板没有去餐厅吃饭啊！
fullTextEN: The shoe store owner didn't go to the restaurant to eat!
Did you guess it?

fullTextZH: 因为鞋店老板每天闻食物的香味，
fullTextEN: Because the shoe store owner smells the food aroma every day,

fullTextZH: 所以餐厅老板要他付钱。
fullTextEN: so the restaurant owner wants him to pay.

fullTextZH: 你看过这么小气的人吗？
fullTextEN: Have you seen such a stingy person?
If you encounter such a person,
wouldn't you be very angry?
Hmm!

fullTextZH: 现在鞋店老板拿到账单，
fullTextEN: Now the shoe store owner received the bill,
what do you think he should do?
The shoe store owner is very angry,
he also finds it very funny,

fullTextZH: 因为他第一次看到这么小气的人。
fullTextEN: because it's the first time he's seen such a stingy person.
He took a cup,
put some coins inside,
and started shaking it.
The money is in the cup,
Ding-a-ling, ding-a-ling!
He shook it,
Shook it for a minute.

fullTextZH: 然后他问餐厅老板：这样够了吗？
fullTextEN: Then he asked the restaurant owner: Is this enough?

fullTextZH: 餐厅老板不知道鞋店老板是什么意思。
fullTextEN: The restaurant owner didn't know what the shoe store owner meant.
So the shoe store owner said,

fullTextZH: 因为我闻了食物的味道，
fullTextEN: Because I smelled the food,
you want me to pay.

fullTextZH: 现在我给你听钱的声音，
fullTextEN: Now I let you hear the sound of money,
If you think it's not enough,
I can keep shaking.
The restaurant owner listened,

fullTextZH: 现在他知道鞋店老板在笑他，
fullTextEN: Now he knows the shoe store owner is laughing at him,
and won't pay him.
So he ran back home.
Today's story is finished.
Now it's your turn to tell,
Have you seen stingy people?

fullTextZH: 他们做了什么小气的事呢？
fullTextEN: What stingy things did they do?

fullTextZH: 我们遇到小气的人应该怎么办呢？
fullTextEN: What should we do when we encounter stingy people?
You're welcome to leave a comment and tell me!
See you next time, bye!
